motivation: Fixed-policy rescoring cannot test observation-noise robustness because final simple regret uses the response mean. This extension reruns the same LLM conditions so changed noise can affect observations and decisions.
primary_estimand: at noise multiplier 2.0, paired site-level final-simple-regret difference for each tool mode minus bare, after averaging provider generation seeds within site
primary_multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction across the three tool-minus-bare contrasts at noise multiplier 2.0
secondary_estimands: difference in each tool-minus-bare contrast between multiplier 2.0 and multiplier 1.0
secondary_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all named secondary contrasts
confidence_intervals: site bootstrap with 10000 resamples and percentile 95% intervals
missing_episode_rule: retry transport and rate failures with the same identity; retain model format failures, infeasible designs, stopping, and forfeited rounds; do not impute unresolved cells
stopping_rule: no efficacy stopping and no inspection of condition effects during execution
site_status: fresh range not used by Phase 4 confirmatory matrices or scripted sensitivity sweeps
precision_note: Sixteen paired sites target a CI much narrower than the original 0.018 material-effect threshold under the primary observed paired SD, while containing API cost.

cost_plan.model_choice_reason: Luna is the frozen primary model; Sol would cost about nineteen times more per historical episode.
